title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Brainstorm Force…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Brainstorm Force CartFlows up to version 3.3.0 due to improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags. This flaw allows an attacker to inject code into web pages. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.3. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
